title: The General Environment and Its Impact on the Prophetic Tarbiyah

text_simplified: The general environment encompasses social, political, economic, cultural, and natural factors that influence human behavior and interactions. The Prophet ﷺ was keen on the tazkiyah (purification) of the environment in its broad sense. Additionally, teaching the Book and wisdom (al-hikmah) was among the most important tarbiyah (upbringing) processes he carried out, for wisdom is divided into theoretical and practical, and the Sunnah is the practical wisdom that guides to correctness in speech and action.
